title: 春の小川 (Haru no Ogawa — The Spring Stream)
description: A tender 1912 song about a gentle stream murmuring through the spring countryside. The brook softly encourages violets and renge flowers on its banks to bloom beautifully. In the second verse, shrimp, killifish, and small carp enjoy the sunny water while the stream whispers for them to play. Inspired by the real Kawabone River near the lyricist's home in what is now Shibuya, Tokyo.
